plan.summary: This 1-4 block fits an off-camp 12-week build. Week 1 establishes simple performance baselines with low-risk rep tests and quality work, then Weeks 2-3 build aerobic capacity, muscular endurance, and basic force production without stealing too much from sparring. Week 4 deloads volume so you stay fresh and can review what is working before the next block.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build aerobic capacity, repeatable work rate, and basic strength-power foundations while Week 1 establishes baselines.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress key lifts and conditioning density carefully while keeping recovery available for boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength and power in place while expressing sharper speed and sport-specific conditioning with low excess fatigue.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump fast and land quietly. Reset between reps and stop if height drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low box and stick the landing.

exercises.name: 2. Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy ramp sets, then find the heaviest clean set of 6-10 reps with solid depth and control. This sets your starting baseline for the block.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your heaviest clean set of 6-10 reps.

exercises.name: 3. Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Keep the back flat and feel the hamstrings. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a loaded backpack or bag if dumbbells are limited.

exercises.name: 4. Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Step back under control and keep the front foot flat. Smooth reps only.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is tight.

exercises.name: 5. Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard and keep ribs down. Stop before the low back sags.

exercises.name: 1. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one clean max-quality set and stop before form breaks. This sets your upper-body baseline for the block.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best clean push-up set.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a bench, sofa, or table edge if floor push-ups are too hard.

exercises.name: 2. One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull the elbow toward the hip and pause briefly at the top. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack One-Arm Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a loaded bag if dumbbells are limited.

exercises.name: 3. Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.notes: Lower under control and drive up fast. Keep the shoulders packed.

substitutionOptions.name: Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a slower lowering phase if dumbbells are unavailable.

exercises.name: 4. Half-Kneeling Overhead Press
exercises.notes: Squeeze the glute on the down knee and keep the ribcage stacked.

substitutionOptions.name: Standing One-Arm Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if kneeling space is limited.

exercises.name: 5. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Straight line from head to heel. Do not let the hips rotate.

exercises.name: Brisk Walk or Easy Jog
exercises.notes: Keep this relaxed and nasal-breathing friendly. You should finish fresher than you started.

endurancePrescription.target: Build aerobic base without adding much fatigue

exercises.name: 1. Squat Jump

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if squat jumps feel awkward.

exercises.name: 2. Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few ramp sets, then perform one hard but clean set of 8 reps. Keep position and do not chase a sloppy finish. This sets your hinge baseline for the block.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your heaviest clean set of 8 reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a loaded bag if dumbbells are limited.

exercises.name: 3. Split Squat
exercises.notes: Stay tall and keep tension in the front leg. Leave 2 reps in reserve.

exercises.name: 4. Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Let the shoulder blade move, then row hard and pause at the top.

substitutionOptions.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a bench, chair, or hand support.

exercises.name: 5. Suitcase Carry
exercises.notes: Walk tall and do not lean toward the weight.

substitutionOptions.name: Suitcase Hold
substitutionOptions.notes: Hold for 20-30 seconds per side if space is limited.

exercises.name: Whole-Body Endurance Circuit
exercises.notes: Move steadily, keep technique clean, and stay one step below all-out. This should build work capacity, not wreck your next boxing session.
